description: This file defines the class Image_Graph_Marker_Pointing, which is a type of marker used in the Image_Graph library. It represents a pointing marker (like a pin) with start and end markers that point to data points on a graph. The class manages drawing such markers on a canvas, including setting start markers and offsets.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Pointing
classes.description: Represents a pointing marker (pin) on a graph, with optional start and end markers, and offsets, for indicating data points visually.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Pointing
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the pointing marker with offsets and the end marker.

methods.name: setMarkerStart
methods.description: Sets the starting marker (tip of the pin) and associates it with this pointing marker.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws the pointing marker on the canvas at given coordinates, including optional start marker and end marker, with line and offsets.
